technicalNotes:
When found in the RoW (Rest of World) market Volkswagen Passat (3C): Headlight Leveling, check TPI 2012732.
If the Fault Code is static (not intermittent) and the Right Subsystem/Slave Swiveling Module has Software Level X017 or lower just replace the Swiveling Module - do NOT replace the Headlight/Housing at this point.
If the Fault Code is intermittent and the Right Subsystem/Slave Swiveling Module has Software Level X017 or lower replace the Swiveling Module and the Headlight/Housing.
If the Right Subsystem/Slave Swiveling Module has Software Level X018 replace only the Headlight/Housing.
